taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: HTTP duplicate-parameter and parser agreement — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Identify the raw parameter encoding and each proxy/framework/validator/consumer parser. Record whether duplicate keys are first, last, list or rejected at each relevant layer.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned fixture send one normal parameter, then one duplicate-key case derived from the parser chain. Capture both the value authorized/validated and the value consumed by the protected operation. Keep framing and unrelated parameters fixed.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Duplicate acceptance is not a vulnerability when every layer agrees or the field is intentionally multi-valued. A different echoed value alone is not a violated authorization/business rule.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Define one supported multiplicity/normalization contract and enforce the same interpreted value at validation and use. Retest normal single and intended multi-value inputs plus the original disagreement.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
